name: POS screen: register
describe: The full POS register at 1440x900: header with Search Menu, 256px category sidebar, All and Special Items pills, a five-column menu grid on gray-50 and the 384px order panel over the footer navigation. One Hummus line is in the cart and its card shows the stepper.
Items, categories and prices bind to data/menus through bindings.json, so render.mjs --menu swaps the menu, language and currency.
